notes: Official Blackmagic techspecs page (W-CONU-11) lists only USB Type-C for power/configuration — there is no separate DC barrel or AC inlet on the unit itself. The "with Power Supply" retail bundle (sold by B&H, Sweetwater, etc.) includes an external 100-240VAC to 5V/2A USB-C power supply with international plug adapters, but it connects to the converter via the same USB-C port (not a distinct port), so it is not modeled as a separate physical port. Max supported resolution is 1080p60 (progressive/interlace formats up to 1080i60), which corresponds to 3G-SDI-class bandwidth; grade set to sdi-3g per the product's "3G" designation and auto-detect SD/HD/3G-SDI support. HDMI input is HDMI Type A, unspecified version number on the spec page — grade omitted since no explicit HDMI version (1.4/2.0/2.1) is stated (max resolution 1080p60 is well within HDMI 1.4 capability, but Blackmagic does not state a version, so grade is left unset per instructions to omit when spec doesn't state a version).

ports.name: SDI Out 1

ports.name: SDI Out 2
ports.note: Auto-detects and outputs SD, HD, or 3G-SDI; user-selectable Level A/B for 3G-SDI

ports.note: Power input (bus-powered, 4.4-5.25V DC, 2W) and configuration via Blackmagic utility; also carries HDMI timecode/config data. Not a data/video signal port.
